title: Concept: Result of send() ignored (solidity) — review required
description: In solidity, send() forwards Ether with a fixed gas stipend and returns false on failure. A contract that ignores the result keeps running after a failed transfer, so its state can disagree with the funds actually moved. The remedy is a require on the returned bool, or a pull-payment pattern.
applicability: solidity contracts that send Ether with send(); deprecated by the Solidity docs, but present in existing code; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Inconsistent accounting after a failed Ether transfer; MEDIUM severity pending the reviewer's analysis of the state change.
